subject: resnet8-cifar10-niosless-jtag-full10k

tool_versions.openvino: 2025.4.0 (runtime install only; not in the deploy loop)

notes: Full CIFAR-10 test set (all 10,000 images), one inference each, on the Nios-less design: no soft CPU, host PC drives a JTAG-to-Avalon master via System Console (tools/run_cifar10_jtag.py + tools/jtag_worker.tcl); CoreDLA k16/c8 FP12AGX (DSP INT9 tensor mode TENSOR1X2_MULT8, 128 int8 MACs/cycle, 24 DSPs), parameters (205,056 B, FNV-1a 0x191007b5, verified by JTAG readback every programming cycle) MIF-baked into on-chip pseudo-DDR RAM; no HyperRAM, no external memory. top1 = 8633/10000 = 86.33% (95% CI 85.66-87.00) vs the 85% MLPerf Tiny closed-division floor and the 86.5% reference-model figure; per-class recall min 71.3% (cat), dominant confusion cat<->dog. METRIC PROVENANCE: fps and latency are the DLA's jobs_active-gated CLOCKS_ACTIVE CSR delta (10 ns ticks at ddr_clk=100 MHz), i.e. descriptor-fetch -> feature-writer-done device time; JTAG transfer is excluded by construction (JTAG-inclusive wall rate was ~57 img/s, input-write bound). Latency is deterministic: 9,748/10,000 jobs read exactly 52,757 ticks; the sub-527.57 us tail (min 520.86) is a reproducible counter settling ramp over the first ~252 jobs of each programming cycle, not data-dependent variation. Run used 2 programming cycles (9,499 + 501 images) to respect the unlicensed-IP inference cap; diagnostics bit 2 never asserted. Integrity: all 10,000 logit vectors distinct; the 200-image ic01 subset ran in both cycles and returned bit-identical logits 200/200. Accuracy oracle is the CIFAR-10 test labels; golden integer TFLite model used for the per-cycle warm-up self-check (argmax must equal 6 on the deterministic synthetic image). NOT an official MLPerf Tiny submission. Companion record ph4_*niosless-jtag-340mhz* pushes the same arch to the 340 MHz silicon ceiling with bit-identical logits on the ic01 subset. The enable_on_chip_parameters weight-storage mode remains defective (input-invariant output; see reports/fpga_ai_streaming_egress_escalation.md, cross-referenced with the July ph3 record's DDR-free-path observation) - it is what blocks the fitted-but-wrong 2x k16c16 core.
